name: aroma-subgraph
description: Indexes Aroma's launches and trading on Arc. Two manifests, one schema: subgraph.yaml is the curve system on Arc testnet, subgraph.pool.yaml is the pool system on Arc mainnet. They cannot be one subgraph because a subgraph's data sources must share a network.

scripts.deploy:pool: graph codegen subgraph.pool.yaml && graph build subgraph.pool.yaml --output-dir build-pool/ && goldsky subgraph deploy aroma-pool/1.0.0 --path build-pool/
